args: for c in T9-P1 T9-P2 T9-P3 T9-P4 T9-P5 T9-P6 T9-P7 T9-P8 T9-P9; do grep -q "$c" design/materialization/D9-OBSERVED-PROOF-HARNESS.md || { echo missing $c; exit 1; }; done; for t in '[RUN]' '[ERR]' '[GAP]' '[UNK]'; do grep -qF "$t" design/materialization/D9-OBSERVED-PROOF-HARNESS.md || { echo missing $t; exit 1; }; done; grep -q 'HISTORICAL CLAIM' design/materialization/D9-OBSERVED-PROOF-HARNESS.md && grep -q 'NO PRODUCTION COMPILER REPAIR' design/materialization/D9-OBSERVED-PROOF-HARNESS.md

for id in $(node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("evidence/D9/summary.json"));console.log(s.obligations.map(o=>o.id).join(" "))'); do grep -q "$id" design/materialization/D9-OBSERVED-PROOF-HARNESS.md || { echo "observed ASCII does not mention $id"; exit 1; }; done; for m in M1 M2 M3 M4 M5 M6 M7 M8; do grep -q "$m-" design/materialization/D9-OBSERVED-PROOF-HARNESS.md || { echo missing $m; exit 1; }; done

tests: observed ASCII names every obligation and mutant with RUN/ERR/GAP/UNK
